description: The guest pass for learning: read what the teacher said in a class, part by part, with the questions and answers. Works with no login for free trial classes (openToGuests is true in jic_classes). Ended classes stay readable. Pass the last n you got as "after" to continue.

after.description: Return parts after this number. Default 0 = from the start.

id.description: Class id (10 hex characters) or class number, from jic_classes

name: jic_class_text
title: Read a free trial class as text (no key)
